C0.loc: Sect. 1 Introduction, p. 722; Sect. 3, Definition 1, p. 727
C0.quote: a map that associates to any coalitional ranking
C0.note: The paper is an axiomatic study of social ranking solutions. These map a single ranking of coalitions of players to a binary relation over the individual players. They are ordinal power or relevance measures, not procedures aggregating several agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting. CP-majority is described with metaphorical coalition 'voters', and the application ranks parties' power in a bicameral legislature. Neither makes the object a voting procedure aggregating agents' inputs. Coding stopped per C0.
